Coverage & sources

Live layers come from Michigan DNR, University of Michigan / IFR, NOAA, county GIS and Regrid / Esri Living Atlas. Empty areas may mean no mapped coverage, not no fish or no access.

Lake depths: historical surveys, not live water levels. Deep points are approximate contour centroids, not surveyed GPS soundings. Inland depth values are feet; NOAA chart units follow the chart.

Access: public ownership does not by itself establish permission to hunt, park or cross a property. Check posted restrictions and site rules.

Parcels: Statewide parcel outlines cover all 83 Michigan counties through Regrid / Esri Living Atlas. Zoom to level 15 or closer; imagery is resampled beyond level 17. Tap parcels for county ownership records where connected: Barry, Berrien, Eaton, Genesee, Lenawee and Ottawa. Other counties have property-record links. No complete statewide owner database is connected. Berrien and Genesee lookups use 2025 source layers; recorded owners may differ from current deeds. Source dates vary, and recent splits or corrections may lag. DNR and Berrien County detail layers remain available separately. Lines are reference boundaries, not surveys or access permission.
